svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.20 MASONRY AND INSULATING CONCRETE FORM WALLS NOT IN CONTACT WITH THE GROUND

g.text: Cavity wall thicker than the foundation wall:
not corbelled, but may project not more
than 25 mm over the outer face of the
Unit masonry foundation wall corbelled to
meet flush with the inner face of the
Cavity wall on a narrower foundation wall
Total corbel not more than one third of
Projection of each course not more than
w/3 and not more than h/2 of the
T = 240 mm: T/3 = 80 mm. Brick unit

svg.text: Cavity walls of greater thickness than the
foundation wall on which they rest are not
but may project 25 mm (1″) over the outer face of
Where that foundation wall is unit masonry, it
may be corbelled to meet flush with the inner
face of the cavity wall, provided
(a) the projection of each course does not exceed
half the height or one third the thickness of the
corbelled unit, and (b) the total corbel does not
exceed one third of the foundation wall
Drawn after Figure A-9.20.12.2.(2): walls cut through, units without cores, cavity tinted blue. Unit sizes are illustration only.
